Welcome to the BASE3 & ILIAS Integration Demo

This is a demonstration site showcasing the technical coexistence of the BASE3 Framework with the ILIAS Learning Management System. It illustrates how BASE3 can serve as a modern, lightweight entry point that complements and extends the capabilities of ILIAS.

What This Site Demonstrates

This demo installation is not a production environment, but a technical proof-of-concept. Its purpose is to show how a BASE3-powered landing page can be positioned in front of an ILIAS instance to:

  • Enhance the initial user experience
  • Provide a customizable and responsive interface
  • Serve as a platform for future extensions, tools, or integrations

All content and functionality presented here is intended for development and testing purposes only.

About BASE3

BASE3 is a flexible and modular PHP framework designed to serve as a lightweight foundation for modern web applications. It focuses on clean structure, clear separation of concerns, and seamless extensibility.

Key features include:

  • Modular architecture
  • Support for dynamic UI components
  • Integration-friendly by design
  • Minimal setup with maximum flexibility

In this demo, BASE3 handles the initial routing, theming, and frontend rendering before delegating control to the ILIAS system when needed.

About ILIAS

ILIAS is a widely used open-source learning management system (LMS) developed for universities, educational institutions, and businesses. It provides robust tools for course management, collaboration, and assessment.

ILIAS excels in:

  • Managing large-scale educational content
  • Providing role-based access and permission systems
  • Supporting SCORM and other e-learning standards

Why Combine BASE3 and ILIAS?

While ILIAS is feature-rich and powerful, its interface can be overwhelming for first-time users or external visitors. BASE3 can act as a smart intermediary layer that:

  • Simplifies the first contact with the platform
  • Provides branding and thematic customization
  • Offers additional services or pre-authentication options

This opens the door for smoother onboarding, integrations with third-party systems, or even microservices that complement ILIAS' core functionality.

Disclaimer

This website is a non-production demo. No real user data is stored or processed here. Its only purpose is to demonstrate the technical feasibility of combining BASE3 and ILIAS in a development environment.

Looking Ahead

Future iterations of this setup may explore:

  • Full single sign-on (SSO) integration
  • Dynamic content previews from ILIAS
  • Role-based dashboards built with BASE3
  • API bridges between custom modules and ILIAS backends

Feedback and collaboration are welcome!
